note: DTN Content Services cash-bids-table-widget. Read from ONE call to https://api.dtn.com/markets/sites/E0266901/cash-bids?units=us — the site id E0266901 carries this location and its neighbours together, so every one of them is a source file and none of them is new code. IT IS READ THROUGH A BROWSER AND NOT BY A FETCH: DTN answered a server-side probe with "The api key is valid, but it is valid to be used within a browser only", so their gateway scopes these widget keys to browser use. poll.mjs loads https://www.premiercooperative.com/agricultural/detailed-cash-bids in a real Chromium and reads the response their own widget asks for, which means we hold no key at all — theirs is public in their page, as it must be for the widget to work. THE LOCATION KEY IS THE NUMERIC location.id (26478) AND NOT THE NAME: a display name is exactly the thing a vendor re-cases, and some of these names are companies rather than towns. cashRounding is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. One run said round-cent (4 testable rows, margin 4) and there is no second run to agree with it. A mode is a property of how they compute their board, so it needs the same answer on a different day's prices. Left off, the identity guard stays exact and a board that does not reconcile refuses loudly instead of publishing under a mode nobody established. COORDINATES ARE NULL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the feed carries no coordinate, and a town centroid is a different place from a yard — measured at 1.4 miles on babgrain-auburn. Geocode the street address before relying on a map pin. Built by scripts/dtn-build.mjs from a dtn-probe log; 4 row(s) for this location. STATE AND ADDRESS READ, NOT INFERRED. Premier, Allied, Country Partners, Country Visions and Ag-Land FS each publish their own locations list; the state and street below were read off it on 2026-08-25 and not inferred from the operator's headquarters. COORDINATES AND POSTCODE READ OFF PREMIER'S OWN LOCATION DIRECTORY, not geocoded. A town centroid is a different place -- it sat 1.4 miles off the yard at Auburn. THEIR OWN DIRECTORY TAGS THIS ONE "Cenex" AND NOT GRAIN, yet it quotes in the bid feed under id 26478. Both facts are true and the feed is the one that decides whether there is a price to publish. Recorded here so the discrepancy is not rediscovered as a bug.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
